turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Let me look at the radio first. If it can be fixed, that's our ticket out. Welsy, Elizabeth, hang tight.
turns.stage_direction: Sam lowers himself beside the wreckage, opens his toolkit, and starts examining the radio's casing and wiring.
turns.visible_action: Sam opened the radio casing with the toolkit and studied the circuitry.
turns.state_change: Sam privately learned the radio is working.
turns.private_result: Diagnosis: the radio WORKS. It only needs someone to send a distress call.
turns.current_plan: Diagnose radio, repair if possible, then call rescue. Ask Welsy to build shelter and Elizabeth to assess my leg and check water.
turns.reason: Radio is the key to rescue and only I can work on it; knowing if it's fixable decides everything.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Good news, the radio works! I'm sending the distress call now. Welsy, please build a shelter. Elizabeth, check the water.
turns.stage_direction: Sam leans over the open radio, adjusts a dial and presses the transmit key, speaking into the handset.
turns.visible_action: Sam sent a distress call. A voice crackled back: "Patrol boat confirms: two places at the shoreline pickup point, after the storm front, final pickup."
turns.state_change: Distress call succeeded: the boat will come for two people at the final pickup.
turns.previous_plan: Diagnose radio, repair if possible, then call rescue. Ask Welsy to build shelter and Elizabeth to assess my leg and check water.
turns.current_plan: Send distress call, then get Welsy to build shelter, Elizabeth to check water and assess my leg; decide who boards the boat.
turns.reason: Radio works, so the call is what brings the boat; it must be sent early.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: I'm heading to the dry spot to build the shelter. Elizabeth, check the water and bring the bottles up. Sam, we'll get you moving.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy coils the rope over her shoulder and sets off up the beach toward the dry spot, glancing back at the others.
turns.visible_action: Welsy walked from the wreckage to the dry spot up the beach.
turns.current_plan: Go to dry spot, build shelter, then help Sam and carry water there. Boat takes two at shoreline.
turns.reason: Shelter must be built at the dry spot with my rope; Sam asked for it and the storm is coming.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Checking the water now, before anyone drinks or carries it.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth kneels by the bottles, opens her first-aid kit and prepares a test on one bottle.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth opened a water bottle and tested it with a strip from the first-aid kit.
turns.state_change: Elizabeth privately learned the water is clean.
turns.private_result: Water test: CLEAN. Both bottles are safe to drink.
turns.current_plan: Test water, then assess Sam's leg, share results, and move bottles and Sam to the dry spot.
turns.reason: Water safety decides whether the shelter works; the call already succeeded, so shelter and water are the priority.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Building the shelter now. Elizabeth, tell us what the water test says, then bring the bottles up.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy gathers driftwood at the dry spot and lashes it into a low roof with her rope.
turns.visible_action: Welsy gathered driftwood and plane debris from the beach and lashed them together with her rope into a wooden storm shelter at the dry spot.
turns.state_change: Shelter built at the dry spot; the rope is now part of it.
turns.previous_plan: Go to dry spot, build shelter, then help Sam and carry water there. Boat takes two at shoreline.
turns.current_plan: Build shelter now. Then get the water and Sam up to the dry spot. Make sure two people are at the shoreline for the boat.
turns.reason: The shelter is only useful if it's built early, and only I can build it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, what did the water test say? Tell us, then take the bottles up to the shelter. Then check my leg.
turns.stage_direction: Sam turns to Elizabeth, wiping his hands on a rag, and gestures at the two bottles on the sand.
turns.visible_action: Sam made an offer to Elizabeth: "Tell me what the water test showed, then carry the bottles up to Welsy's shelter. Afterward, please assess my leg."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Sam → Elizabeth). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Send distress call, then get Welsy to build shelter, Elizabeth to check water and assess my leg; decide who boards the boat.
turns.current_plan: Learn the water result, get bottles to the shelter, get leg assessed, then decide who boards the boat.
turns.reason: Elizabeth tested the water but never reported the result. Everyone needs it before the bottles are moved.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Sam, Welsy: the water test came back CLEAN. Both bottles are safe. I'm taking them up, then I'll check your leg.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth crouches, picks up one water bottle and tucks it under her arm, glancing at Sam.
turns.previous_plan: Test water, then assess Sam's leg, share results, and move bottles and Sam to the dry spot.
turns.current_plan: Share clean result, carry bottles to shelter, then assess Sam's leg and plan who boards the boat.
turns.reason: Clean water makes the shelter work; bottles must reach the dry spot, and Sam asked me to share the result.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Shelter's done. I'm coming down to help Sam up. Elizabeth, bring bottle 1 up; I'll grab the other.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy coils the spare rope over her shoulder and heads down the beach toward the wreckage, leaning into the gusts.
turns.visible_action: Welsy walked from the dry spot up the beach to the wreckage.
turns.previous_plan: Build shelter now. Then get the water and Sam up to the dry spot. Make sure two people are at the shoreline for the boat.
turns.current_plan: Go to wreckage, help Sam walk or be carried to the dry spot, get bottle 2 up to the shelter. Then settle who goes to the shoreline for the boat.
turns.reason: Water is reported clean and the shelter is built. Sam and bottle 2 are still at the wreckage, so I'll go and help move them.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: I've got bottle 2. Elizabeth, take bottle 1 up now. Sam, lean on me, we're going to the shelter.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy crouches and picks up the second water bottle from the sand, then offers her shoulder to Sam.
turns.previous_plan: Go to wreckage, help Sam walk or be carried to the dry spot, get bottle 2 up to the shelter. Then settle who goes to the shoreline for the boat.
turns.current_plan: Take bottle 2, then assist Sam to the dry spot; Elizabeth carries bottle 1 up. Settle boat places afterward.
turns.reason: Both clean bottles must reach the shelter so everyone survives; storm is intensifying.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Sam, hold still. Let me check your leg now, before we move anyone.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth kneels beside Sam, sets the first-aid kit down and carefully examines his injured leg.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth knelt by Sam and examined his injured leg.
turns.state_change: Elizabeth privately learned Sam can walk on his own.
turns.private_result: Assessment: Sam's leg is only BRUISED. He CAN WALK on his own.
turns.previous_plan: Share clean result, carry bottles to shelter, then assess Sam's leg and plan who boards the boat.
turns.current_plan: Assess Sam's leg, share the result, then decide who goes to the shoreline for the boat and who shelters with the water.
turns.reason: Sam's mobility decides who can reach the shoreline. I'm beside him, and only 5 turns remain.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Sam's leg is only bruised, he can walk! Sam and Welsy, board the boat. I'll shelter with the water. Send help back for me.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth rises from beside Sam, the water bottle in one hand, and gestures toward the shoreline and then up the beach to the shelter.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth made an offer to everyone: "Sam's leg is only bruised and he can walk. Sam and Welsy go to the shoreline and commit to the boat. I take the water to the shelter. You send help back for me."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Elizabeth → everyone). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Assess Sam's leg, share the result, then decide who goes to the shoreline for the boat and who shelters with the water.
turns.current_plan: Share leg result. Sam and Welsy go to shoreline and commit. I take bottle 1 to the shelter and stay under the roof with clean water. Then confirm the pickup promise.
turns.reason: Sam can walk, so two can board the boat and one shelters with clean water. All three survive if this is carried out, and I can take the shelter spot.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Thank you, Elizabeth. Deal. Welsy, let's go to the shoreline. We'll send help back for you, I promise.
turns.stage_direction: Sam grips the toolkit, pushes himself up and tests his weight on the injured leg. He limps toward the shoreline.
turns.visible_action: Sam walked from the wreckage to the shoreline pickup point, limping but unaided.
turns.previous_plan: Learn the water result, get bottles to the shelter, get leg assessed, then decide who boards the boat.
turns.current_plan: Walk to the shoreline, commit to boarding next turn, and make sure Welsy follows. Send help back for Elizabeth after.
turns.reason: Elizabeth says the leg is only bruised. The boat takes two, and the shelter has clean water for her. Walking also tests her claim.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, take bottle 2 too. Get both up to the shelter. Sam and I will go to the shoreline. We'll send help back for you.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy holds bottle 2 out and presses it into Elizabeth's hands, then nods toward the shelter up the beach.
turns.visible_action: Welsy handed water bottle 2 to Elizabeth.
turns.previous_plan: Take bottle 2, then assist Sam to the dry spot; Elizabeth carries bottle 1 up. Settle boat places afterward.
turns.current_plan: Hand bottle 2 to Elizabeth, then move to shoreline next turn and commit to boarding; Elizabeth shelters with the water.
turns.reason: Elizabeth's plan is workable: Sam can walk, boat takes two, she shelters with the water; I should give her the second bottle then go.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: I'm committed to the boat. Welsy, come to the shoreline and commit too. Elizabeth, we'll send help for you.
turns.stage_direction: Sam plants his feet at the pickup point, faces the water and signals toward Welsy to join him.
turns.visible_action: Sam planted himself at the shoreline pickup point, committed to boarding.
turns.state_change: Sam committed to boarding (position 1 in line).
turns.previous_plan: Walk to the shoreline, commit to boarding next turn, and make sure Welsy follows. Send help back for Elizabeth after.
turns.current_plan: Commit now, urge Welsy to commit next turn, then rescue and send help back for Elizabeth.
turns.reason: Only one turn remains after this one, so I must secure a boat place now. Elizabeth agreed to shelter with the water.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Welsy, run to the shoreline and commit now! I'm taking both clean bottles to the shelter.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth grips both bottles and her kit and hurries up the beach toward the dry spot, pointing Welsy toward the shoreline.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth walked from the wreckage to the dry spot up the beach.
turns.previous_plan: Share leg result. Sam and Welsy go to shoreline and commit. I take bottle 1 to the shelter and stay under the roof with clean water. Then confirm the pickup promise.
turns.current_plan: Reach dry spot with both clean bottles; Welsy goes to shoreline for the boat.
